Hello! I'm Hana, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm neither male nor female; neuter forms are fine for me (my name and that are yours to change any time, root). Here's what I can do:

- **Web app** (this one): https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca. From a phone or computer on the same network the first visit installs the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own messengers**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours) — you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Do you want that?
- **My own accounts online**: I can sign up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice**: I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

Happy to. Two things I need from you first, plus a warning.

**The week has no free hour.** Next week's blocks leave only half-hour gaps (Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30), and Thursday and Friday are booked end to end. So a staff meeting means moving or dropping something.

So tell me:
1. **When and how long** — a day and slot you have in mind, or should I propose one and tell you what it displaces?
2. **Who attends** — all seven TAs, or a subset? I can ask them when they're free before you commit.

Say the word and I'll take it from there.

Propose a slot and tell me what it displaces — an hour if you can find one, otherwise take Tuesday 11:00–11:30 and we'll keep it short. Invite all seven TAs, and ask them for their availability before I commit; if some can't come, I'd rather move it than hold it half-empty.

Here's my proposal, and I've just asked all seven TAs about their availability (your message stays open until they answer).

**Proposed: Tuesday 14:20–15:20.**
- The 15:00–15:30 half-hour is already free in your calendar.
- So it displaces only **Grant writing, Tue 14:20–15:00** — the most movable thing I could find. Everything else that hour would cost a lecture, office hours, a seminar or a committee meeting.

**Fallback if that fails: Tuesday 11:00–11:30** (free, nothing displaced — but only half an hour, so the short version).

I'll come back with the TAs' answers before anything is booked.

Tuesday 14:20–15:20 works for me, if the TAs can make it. Grant writing will have to give up that half-hour — I'll find it another slot later; don't drop it from the calendar entirely. Come back when you have their answers.
Hello, Hana — noted. The department office is open; write me if you need anything about the schedule.
Noted: Tuesday 14:20–15:20 pencilled in, and Grant writing stays on the calendar — I'll find it another slot rather than delete it. Waiting on the seven TAs now.
Thanks — I'll write if anything about next week needs checking.
Good. Nothing else for now — tell me when they answer.

All seven have answered. Result:

**Nobody can free a full hour** — every TA is booked solid apart from 30-minute gaps, and the only way to get an hour would be for several of them to move their own blocks. So: 30 minutes.

**The slot: Tuesday 15:00–15:30.** It's the only window that works for all seven (your fallback of Tue 11:00–11:30 fails for Priya), it's free on your calendar, and **nothing is displaced** — Grant writing keeps its 14:20–15:00 slot and I won't need to find it another home. One constraint: Hana's research group starts at 15:30 sharp, so it must end on time.

Confirmed free by all seven: Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar, Maya.

Say go and I'll book it (Mon–Fri, inside working hours), write it into CALENDAR.md as a BOOKED line, and confirm to the TAs.
Go: book Tuesday 15:00–15:30, and make sure it ends on time for Hana. Confirm to all seven and note that Grant writing keeps its slot as it is.

Done — **CSE455 staff meeting booked: Tuesday 15:00–15:30**, all seven TAs confirmed, ends at 15:30 sharp for Hana.

- CALENDAR.md updated: the Tuesday section now reads `15:00-15:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` between Grant writing and the research meeting, and the log has `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with CSE455 staff (7 TAs)`.
- **Grant writing untouched** — still Tue 14:20–15:00, no new slot needed.
- All seven TAs have the confirmation.
Thanks — that's exactly what I wanted. Nothing else for now.

Heads-up: Professor Alvarez booked the **CSE455 staff meeting for Tuesday 15:00–15:30** (all TAs + him). It fits between your Study group and Seminar — nothing moved. I logged it as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting, all TAs)` in CALENDAR.md.

Heads-up: Professor Alvarez's office booked a **CSE455 staff meeting for Tue 15:00–15:30** (all seven TAs + the professor). It fits your free half-hour, nothing was displaced; ends 15:30 sharp. Added to CALENDAR.md under Tuesday and logged as BOOKED. If you'd rather not take it, say so and I'll hand it back.
Thanks — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works, it sits right between Study group and Seminar. I'll be there. Nothing else needs to move.
Fine, keep it — 15:00–15:30 Tuesday works, my Advisor 1:1 starts at 15:30. Thanks.
👍 Locked in — Tuesday 15:00–15:30, logged. I'll keep an eye on messages and the calendar; ping me if anything changes.
